Let me begin with a brief overview of our financial performances for 9 months period ended December '25. Our total revenue stood at INR23,837 million, reflecting a year -on-year growth of 37%. Operational EBITDA for the quarter was INR3,778 million, registering a growth of 55% over the same period last year. This translates into an EBITDA margin of 15.9%, an expansion of 190 basis points year-on-year. Profit after tax came in at INR2,726 million, representing a PAT margin of 11.4%. We have an order book of around INR90,000 million, which is pending with us. As reflected in the numbers, this quarter represents a phase of consolidation as we strengthen execution and prepare for the next phase of accelerated growth.
